You'll bring: Current enrolment in, or recent completion of, an Engineering degree (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Structural or a related field) Working knowledge of AutoCAD Confidence with Microsoft Office, especially Excel Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail Clear communication and a team-first attitude The ability to juggle multiple tasks and prioritise well A willingness to learn, ask questions and take on new challenges Availability to travel to project sites and work across office and field environments when needed Previous internships or project experience are a bonus, but not essential.
